purpose: Measure loss of out-of-domain forecasting capability after target fine-tuning, and ask whether CKA orders it.
primary_readout: retention_pct = (MSE_finetuned - MSE_zeroshot) / MSE_zeroshot * 100 on each out-of-domain dataset; positive = the capability got worse

contrasts.forgetting_due_to_encoder: ret_B - ret_H per (cell, ood dataset), paired on seed

thresholds.harmful_forgetting_rule: ret_B - ret_H >= 10 pp in every seed of a (cell, ood dataset) pair
thresholds.cka_predicts_rule: Spearman rho between (1 - CKA on the ood inputs) and ret_B over all B (cell, ood dataset, seed) records >= 0.5, with a 95% bootstrap interval resampling whole cells that excludes 0

outcomes_fixed_in_advance: O1: some (cell, ood dataset) pair meets the harmful-forgetting rule AND CKA meets the cka_predicts_rule -> out-of-domain forgetting exists here and CKA orders it; the paper's negative claim is restricted to target-task outcomes.

O2: some pair meets the harmful-forgetting rule AND CKA does not meet the cka_predicts_rule -> forgetting exists and CKA does not order it; this supplies the positive cases the matrix lacks and extends the negative claim to forgetting proper.
O3: no pair meets the harmful-forgetting rule -> no out-of-domain forgetting at this scale; reported as such, and the CKA association is reported descriptively only.
also_reported: target-task test MSE of every rerun beside the matrix record it repeats, as a reproducibility check
CKA on the target inputs (from the training record) against mean ret_B, per cell
checkpoint_policy: Moirai-Small checkpoints are kept. Base and Large checkpoints are deleted after every retention JSON for that checkpoint exists, with their SHA-256 recorded first, because the disk cannot hold them.
what_this_cannot_show: The out-of-domain datasets are the paper's own benchmarks, not Moirai's pre-training corpus, so this measures transfer capability on held-out series, not retention of the pre-training distribution itself.
